title: High peak
desc: A single steep peak in dense ballpoint hatching, with clouds and a stand of pines.

title: Small peak
desc: A compact peak in quick violet-blue ballpoint strokes. Holds up at small sizes.

title: Grid peak
desc: A tall peak above a band of mist, in fine lines. The grid paper behind it is removed and the base fades out softly.

title: Contour range
desc: A whole range of peaks in pen, with contour lines drifting through the sky. Busy, so best large or as a background.

title: 1934 ridge
desc: A ridge sketched on the spot in parallel hatching, dated 26 September 1934. The handwritten note is removed.

title: Brush ridge
desc: A loose ridge in bold brush strokes and watery wash. The paler wash stays semi-transparent, so the ground shows through it.

title: Peaks and waves
desc: Jagged peaks over curling waves, a bold linocut. Ink only: the sky and the map it was printed on are removed. The lighter blues suit pale grounds and backgrounds.

title: Peaks and waves on a map
desc: The same linocut keeping the old map inside the mountains; only the sky is removed. The black is the original print.
